decision.summary: A transient 3D perturbation centered at indices 522–523 is evident: U drops sharply (~−2.9 MAD), N and E rise concurrently. U shows partial recovery by index 525 but remains offset; no clear opposing return observed within allowed context [485,560]. No other temporary offsets confirmed in this region. The candidate jump at index 495 is not supported by adjacent samples (N/E/U show smooth variation across 494–496); it is rejected as noise or artifact.
